_doc: Owner decisions that override the mapping rules for one object of one scope. dpv1_mapping.py applies them on every refresh; the row keeps its DPV1 name and gets the decided action, target and a note with who decided and when. Actions: drop, translate, merge, rebuild, replace, upstream, product, shared. Keys: sds = source dataset scopes, dp = data product scopes, estate = objects outside every scope. Optional 'target' sets the Fabric target or the scope that owns the object.
